triplets.subject: And
triplets.evidence_span:
Our empirical contribution is a diagnostic and falsification audit: it measures what direct null-coordinate edits can
control, records their post-freeze fabrication–deletion cost
among five Whisper-small checkpoint conditions, and identifies where stronger representation, prior-shift, risk-frontier,
and cross-family hypotheses fail.

triplets.subject: Patch Pair
triplets.evidence_span: Every stock/patch pair uses the same decoder.

triplets.subject: Separate Long-Form Test
triplets.evidence_span:
The separate long-form test reduces gap
words but increases WER.

triplets.subject: Trained Row
triplets.evidence_span:
The trained row reduces clip-level LOR from 91.7% to 3.3% (zero on silence, music, events, and urban audio), but deletes
33.05 reference words/min versus stock’s 1.58.

triplets.subject: Nmt Quality
triplets.evidence_span:
AED dose response uses 150 non-speech and 60
speech clips; NMT quality uses real-source WMT19.

triplets.subject: Interval
triplets.evidence_span: The interval uses only the calibration pool.

triplets.subject: Weaker Systems
triplets.evidence_span: Strong CTC systems reach near-zero via anchor fine-tuning; weaker systems reduce monotonically under one scalar.
